thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging eng-oncall — incident detected for customer 'Borealis' (VPC / dedicated). High rate of tool/function-call failures (>30% errors) against their dedicated pool. Root cause looks like parser/schema mismatch after a recent config propagation. Please ack and triage.
jamie: acked. i'm on it. grabbing logs and scope. any immediate customer-facing impact known?
marta: i'm seeing a spike in 400-level errors from the toolcall gateway for tenant borealis. looks like the function-calling payloads now include `meta.context` as an object instead of the expected string. parser throws `ParseError: unexpected token` while extracting tool args.
marta: sample error from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-15T18:27:03Z ERROR toolcall-gw[req=0xa3] ParseError: unexpected token at position 128
payload: {"fn":"price_quote","args":{"symbol":"ACME","meta.context":{"user_tier":"gold"}}}
```
devin: that `meta.context` key with a dot is causing our JSONPath-based extractor to treat it as nested access; prior parser treated it as a literal key. did config for `jsonpath_mode` change in the parser image rollout?
samir: i rolled a parser image (parser:v2.1) to the dedicated pool 20m ago to add a small performance fix. v2.1 switched from permissive-key parsing to strict JSONPath semantics (accidentally). reverting should fix quickly.
jamie: can we do a fast mitigation before a full rollback? customer is seeing ~37% fail rate right now according to metrics.
marta: short mitigation options:
- enable a tenant-scoped feature flag `use_legacy_tool_parser` (fast, immediate)
- apply a gateway shim to rewrite keys with dots to quoted keys
- revert parser image to v2.0 (clean but heavier)
devin: i can flip the feature flag for borealis now via the control plane api. doing it will avoid redeploys.
devin: command i will run:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.internal/api/tenants/borealis/flags \
  -d '{"use_legacy_tool_parser": true}'
```
marta: if you flip the flag, i'll watch for error rate drop and sanity-check logs. also prepping a temporary shim in case the flag doesn't fully cover edge cases.
alisha: i need to prep comms. what's the customer-facing statement? short and non-technical.
jamie: suggested CS blurb: "We're aware of intermittent function-call failures in your VPC and have applied a mitigation. Our engineering team is monitoring and will follow up once fully resolved."
alisha: ok will send that once we confirm mitigation. also can we give a rough ETA? 
marta: if the flag flips cleanly we should see improvement within 2–3 minutes; full validation ~15–20 minutes.
devin: flag flip now.
infra-bot: deploy-event: feature-flag-update for tenant=borealis by user=devin accepted (req=0xb4) 
marta: seeing immediate drop in parser errors. error rate down from 37% -> 4% within 90s. p95 latency stable. continuing monitoring.
samir: i'll prepare a minimal hotfix to make parser v2.1 accept literal keys with dots by falling back to permissive-key mode when a tenant flag is set. patch ready for quick rollout if needed.
marta: heads-up: a few requests still failing due to other inconsistencies (args shape changed for one internal tool). i've opened a short-lived ticket and will map the remaining failure signatures.
jamie: CS ready to send update. Alisha, send the blurb now with :white_check_mark: that mitigation applied and we're monitoring.
alisha: sent to Borealis support alias. message: "We've applied a mitigation to address intermittent function-call parsing errors in your VPC. Our engineers are monitoring and will confirm when fully recovered."
alisha: customer responded: "Thanks — seeing less failures now, please keep us posted." :mailbox_with_mail:
marta: errors at ~0.6% now, mostly edge cases; i'll keep watch and follow up in 30m with a postmortem entry. tagged the failing request ids in the incident ticket.
samir: pushing hotfix to staging now; if tests look good will promote to canary for borealis tomorrow morning. hotfix is a single env toggle `PARSER_PERMISSIVE_KEYS=true` in the container.
samir: hotfix snippet:
```
# in parser container env
PARSER_PERMISSIVE_KEYS=true
# rebuild image (minor)
docker build -t parser:v2.1-hotfix .
kubectl set image deploy/parser parser=parser:v2.1-hotfix -n dedicated-borealis
```
jamie: nice. for now we keep the tenant flag on until hotfix is in canary and validated. after that we'll schedule a controlled rollout + monitor.
oncall-bot: handoff reminder — next oncall (marta) will own follow-ups. closing pager but keeping thread open for the 30m watch window.
marta: will file an incident postmortem with timeline, root cause (parser semantics change), customer impact metrics, mitigation steps, and recommendations (test for dotted keys, add schema fuzz tests). assigning owners.
jamie: thanks team. nice quick triage. :thumbsup:
alisha: customer updated: "App behaviour normal, thanks for fast response." closing on our side pending postmortem.
marta: marking service as recovered. final error rate 0.4% and falling. will post the postmortem link here when ready.
oncall-bot: incident resolved for tenant=borealis (incident_id=INC-20260315-302).
